required_work_gate: Identify an eligible post-Tower caller or independent post-Tower activity/interaction and the relevant event or dependency.
Apply explicit quest-context exclusions and preserve original Tower execution.
Establish why the finding affects Johnny dialogue, V reactions or the safety of a contemplated edit.
Only then promote a diagnostic to required investigation or repair. Unknown relevance remains a source candidate, not an automatic project blocker.
counting_rules: Separate raw source inventory, private-source candidates, eligible post-Tower occurrences, reviewed selections and applied edits.
The 375 unresolved dialogue records and 8828 unresolved choices are global corpus counts, not measured post-Tower gaps.
The private subset has five unresolved dialogue events and 92 choices. Those remain source candidates, and the private subset is not the entire scope.
Native and shared callers remain covered; do not narrow the project to the private payload.
Do not exclude resources solely because a path contains main_quests, versions, gold, old, debug or test. Use caller/owner context and policy.
Do not infer that a missing standalone provider is a broken job without checking embedded ownership and the actual caller.
